entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I... I need to return something. These shoes. The website was a bit confusing and I'm not sure what to do.

I can certainly help you with that. I just need to pull up your account with your phone number. One moment... Okay, I see your recent order for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, um, I guess preference? I tried them on a ride, and they just gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I also had a really hard time with the cleats; I just couldn't get them positioned right. It's all a bit much. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. I'm sorry to hear the cycling shoes weren't a good fit and were causing blisters. Let me check the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I see here that your order was delivered 13 days ago. And thank you for being a VeloFit VIP member, by the way. I see you've been with us for a while.
Oh, I have? That's nice. So... can I return them?

Absolutely. Our policy for standard gear like shoes allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that window. I've just initiated the return process for you. You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next 15 minutes.
Oh, wow. That was... easy. Thank you. I was so worried.

It's no trouble at all. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method. And as a thank you for your loyalty, I've also waived the return shipping fee. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've been a great help!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
